item.title: Why Prosecuting Oil Traders Matters More Than Sinking Tankers
item.description: Russia’s oil trade survives through legal loopholes, shell companies, and intermediaries, not tankers alone— making courtrooms a more effective battlefield than risky escalation at sea.
